result.summary: The page is mostly functional, but there is a clear data-display bug and a couple of minor truncation/clipping issues.

issues.description: The delivery fee for 'Smash Bros Burgers' is displayed as '€NaN delivery', indicating a malformed or missing numeric value.
issues.suggestion: Fix the underlying price data or add a fallback formatter so invalid/missing values show a meaningful message (e.g., 'Delivery fee unavailable') instead of 'NaN'.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is partially cut off on the right edge and its name 'Trattoria Picco...' is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal padding or adjust the card/carousel width so the edge of the next card is fully visible and long restaurant names can wrap or use a larger visible area.

issues.description: The bottom of the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza image) is clipped by the bottom of the visible screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so the last items are not obscured by the bottom tab bar.
